description_en: Retrieves a list of personal drives and their basic information for all users in an enterprise network drive
description_zh: 查询企业网盘内所有用户个人盘的列表及基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-cloud-drive-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-0662240000 --end-user-id alice --max-results 10 --next-token aGN4YzAxQGNuLWhhbmd6aG91LjExNzU5NTMyNjgzMTQ10000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudDriveUsers

parameters.help_en: The region ID. To obtain a list of supported regions, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise network drive
parameters.name: cds_id

parameters.help_en:
The end user ID.

If specified, the query returns only the personal drive of that user. If left empty, the query returns the personal drives of all users
parameters.help_zh:
终端用户ID。

如果不为空，则只查询当前用户的个人盘；如果为空，则查询所有用户的个人盘
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

- Maximum: 100.

- Default: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

- 最大值：100。
- 默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results. This is the `NextToken` value from the previous response. Leave this parameter empty for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token
